rationale: The unifying principle identified with Love (ⲁⲅⲁⲡⲏ) in this kephalaion. Etymology uncertain — possibly related to a Lyc. cognate of ⲱⲧⲡ̄ 'be joined' or to a binding-stem. The function (joining Greatness to land/Aeons/Church into one body) supports 'bond.' Recurs lines 1, 3-4.

proposed_english: face of love / visible aspect of love
rationale: ϩⲟ 'face' applied to the Apostle as the visible-correspondential manifestation of agape within the Church (line 17). The Apostle IS the face of love kata body and kata pneuma, paralleling Love-as-bond at the Greatness register.

Lines 5-6 ⲁⲡⲓ̈|ϣⲧ. Likely an unusual orthographic rendering of ⲁⲡⲓⲱⲧ 'to the Father' with ϣⲧ for ⲱⲧ. Could alternatively be ⲡⲓ-ϣⲧ 'this bond,' but the apposition with 'Master of the All' favors 'Father.' Flag for parallel attestations.

Lyc. ⲛ-ⲧⲉϩ-ⲙⲏⲥⲉ 'of her offspring' — possessive prefix ⲧⲉϩ- (fem. 'her') + ⲙⲏⲥⲉ 'birth, begetting, offspring' (cf. ⲧⲙⲏⲥⲉ in accumulated vocabulary). Used here of the offspring of destruction that Hatred itself destroyed.
